description: Run whole-story task proof and evidence-driven repair before review.

steps.label: Prepare final validation task when needed

content: Follow $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Prepare this proof invocation in the active story plan. Run the existing plan status helper freshly. When all existing tasks are complete, including a deliberate new start with all tasks complete, prepare a fresh final validation task once for this invocation with the applicable whole-story automated and manual guidance and current repository rules. When any task is open, keep the existing plan and do not create a task. Preserve existing evidence, proof restrictions and caller commit boundaries. If task state or identity cannot be established, stop unresolved; do not guess or claim completion.

steps.label: Exit when story tasks are complete
steps.question: Follow $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. READ ONLY loop control: run `python3 "$CODEINFO_ROOT/scripts/plan_status.py"` freshly in the target repository. Answer yes only if the command succeeds and valid JSON has `story_complete` exactly true; answer no only if it succeeds and that field is exactly false. This is task completion only; do not consider manual acceptance or review state. On failed command, missing or malformed output, or a non-boolean field, do not guess either answer: fail this decision as unresolved. Return exactly {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"} for a valid result.

content: Follow $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Own orchestration for at most one task: use `python3 "$CODEINFO_ROOT/scripts/select_current_task.py"` and bind the selected task identity before work. Use your own best judgment to delegate implementation and automated testing to appropriate subagents within their authorized scopes and caller commit boundary. Implement subtasks first, then automated proof. Investigate terminal failures, make authorized fixes and targeted retests internally; after individual failures clear, run the required full suite. Respect all task and repository proof restrictions, independent safe work and actual evidence. Await workers, avoid races and unchanged retries; handle genuine blockers or no safe progress with a bounded incomplete outcome and precise evidence. For hung subprocesses investigate actual progress and wrapper heartbeat rules, bound only genuinely stalled operations, and clean up only processes and resources owned by this work. Never claim missing proof passed. Do not select another task.

Verify each subtask and testing checkbox against evidence, update status and notes honestly, and mark done only when its required work and permitted proof are complete. Preserve exclusions and exact proof limits; record failures, unavailable evidence, blockers and no-safe-progress reasons. Report the actual outcome and remaining obligations for the caller, including owned cleanup. Do not select or start the next task, execute proof, or claim missing proof passed.

Do not treat missing proof as a pass or repeat an unchanged failed attempt. On uncertain identity or insufficient evidence, fail unresolved rather than guess. content: Follow $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Use the final task guidance and current repository rules to check the whole story against the actual candidate, including owned staged, unstaged and untracked changes. Record exact candidate-tied outcomes, exclusions, human-only or unavailable surfaces and remaining proof limits. On actionable in-scope findings, investigate and reopen that same final task as __in_progress__, uncheck every Testing checkbox while preserving notes, and add specific repair and applicable regression-test subtasks; do not edit code or select another task. On a clean manual pass leave tasks complete. Report explicitly authorized exclusions and human-only scenarios separately; they do not constitute a failed manual invocation in the absence of other failures. Record unavailable or inconclusive observations accurately without inventing defects, checkmarks or a special manual-top-break condition. If required proof remains unresolved or cannot safely progress, report the precise limitation and remaining obligations honestly; do not count missing proof as a pass. Respect proof restrictions, process ownership and caller commit boundaries.
